pass_a_gloss: After the entry into the city and the casting-out of the selling-ones from the temple, the chief-priests seek in what authority these things he-does. But he counter-asks about the baptism of John, and convicts the hypocrisy of those not wanting to-say from heaven or from humans. Thus the authority of the Word becomes-manifest to the fruit-bearing-ones, but is-hidden to those leaves only having. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: After the entry and the casting out of sellers from the temple, the chief priests ask [[by what authority >> Bible:Matthew 21:23]]. He counters with John’s baptism and exposes those unwilling to say whether it was from heaven or from humans. So the Word’s authority is plain to fruit-bearers and hidden to leaf-only trees. Glory to Christ. Amen.
